## Goal
Each scan stores one audit event with an entry per site (`engine/exposure.py:703-731`), and every dashboard read decodes it. With 428 sites it must stay small. Tests only: build an `ExposureResult` for 430 fake sites (a quarter found, some with 3 listings each) and a fake store, run `_save`, and check the stored detail size and shape. A budget breach is reported as a finding with file:line and a strict xfail, not edited.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
1. The JSON of the saved event detail for 430 sites with 100 listings is under 250 KB (the test documents the measured number).
2. It contains no URL (`http`), no email address, no digit run of 7 or more (phone-like), and no listing text: only ids, enums, counts and ISO timestamps (sentinel fake values prove it).
3. Listing entries refer to listing ids, never URLs (`exposure.py:710-714`).
4. A scan with 0 sites and a scan with 1 site both save and read back through `latest_exposure`.
5. Round trip: `latest_exposure` after `_save` returns equal entries for the same registry (broker ids, statuses, match levels, counts).
6. No network; no real store (use the fake or the in-memory store the existing tests use; look in `tests/test_exposure*.py`).

This is Codex code-lane work (owner, 2026-11-09): fix and improve the listed module(s) directly, with tests; don't xfail a bug you can fix here. No contract changes: public function signatures, `src/freemyid/models.py`, `interfaces.py`, schema files, `--json` shapes and documented CLI output stay as they are (additive helpers inside the listed files are fine). If the work turns out to need a contract change, stop and say so in VENDOR_STATUS.md "Questions for the owner". Fake data only, offline (fake fetchers, no network), Windows-safe paths in tests (`tmp_path`, `pathlib`, no `/tmp`). Typed, ruff-clean, small diff. Line numbers are from main at the time of writing (2026-11-09); re-check them.
